caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented mirror with a rectangular reflective surface set within a wooden frame. The frame is brown with carved decorative elements at the top and bottom. The top section features an ornate, symmetrical crest with curved cutouts and an inlaid yellow and green floral motif. The lower section of the frame also includes a carved, downward-pointing decorative piece highlighted with a yellow accent and a central white detail. The mirror itself is rendered with faint diagonal shading to suggest reflection. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned except for a small, subtle signature "ARTHUR JOHNSON" in the lower right corner.
title: Mirror
